Class RaspberryPiServerService

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.services.RaspberryPiServerService
@Service public class RaspberryPiServerService extends Object
Service responsible for server-to-Raspberry Pi communication.

This service acts as an HTTP client that sends configuration updates, sensor commands, and system instructions to Raspberry Pi devices.

Responsibilities include: - Sending configuration and threshold updates - Managing sensor station connections and setup - Triggering scans and heartbeat checks - Resolving violations and updating occupancy state

All communication is performed via REST calls with robust error handling and mapped to PiRequestResult outcomes.
